note: v5 -> v6 method migration. Every field here is an honest re-description of what the v5 claim already records; no statement, limit, support cell, trial count or confound is changed. evidence_form classifies the comparison the claim rests on. attribution records whether the headline delta may be attributed to a named component. control_coverage records whether a control that can fire under the claim's own workload was exercised.

evidence_form_values.isolate: exactly one decision differs across the cited pair(s); the delta may be attributed to it
evidence_form_values.interaction: two decisions are crossed; the interaction, not either main effect, is the result
evidence_form_values.package: several decisions change together; a component may only be named if isolated_by supports it
evidence_form_values.not_applicable: the claim is not a variant comparison: a gap, a census, a labelling fact or a single sustained cell

isolated_by: 01 d20->d22 read side (flag vs index on existing derived state)
attribution.note: The read-side contrast is a clean location/index pair. The write side is confounded because d22 also maintains D4's multi-column rollup package (conf-02).

Answerability across 15 designs is a schema census, not a variant comparison. The +33-35% storage delta belongs to the whole X1 package (CAS + ledger).
P3->X1 changes CAS plus an append-only ledger, and its two arms changed buyer count and design order together (conf-05), so no isolation supports the ratio.
This claim's whole point is that the PostgreSQL ratio is unsettled by order and buyer count; the YugabyteDB range is the usable part.
A refusals claim, not a throughput claim; the retry-once variant is the isolating change.
Row-versus-document seat maps are a family/package contrast (conf-03); L3's point-lookup collapse is a layout package, not one decision.
1.76x is an upper bound because the run could not separate the lock's effect from per-retry harness work; the v2 retries-disabled control narrows the attributable advantage to about 1.19x.
The strongest isolation pair in the corpus: x2 differs from n4 only in where the harness calls the recompute.
